title: Date calculator
description: Compare ISO dates, add calendar periods, count workdays and find anniversaries. Pure dates are independent of time zones.
constrain: Month and year calculations constrain invalid dates to the final day of the month. Example: January 31 + one month → February 28 or 29.
listHint: Enter ISO dates separated by spaces, commas or newlines. Monday–Friday are workdays by default. An explicit working date overrides a day off, including weekends. No national holiday calendar is applied.
intervalHint: Counts start date through the day before end date by default. Reverse ranges return a negative count. The inclusive option also counts the end date.
invalidDate: Use a valid ISO date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
invalidAmount: Enter a whole number within ±1,000,000 and select a supported unit.
outOfRange: The calculated date is outside the supported range.
rangeTooLarge: Choose a workday range shorter than 1,000 years.
futureOrigin: The birth or anniversary date must not follow the reference date.
countdownHint: For a countdown, use today as the start and choose the target as the end. Past targets return a negative day count. Anniversary ages use the final day of February for February 29 in non-leap years.
name: Date calculator
